scope: Synthetic Linux Node/SQLite and in-process authenticated API/recovery verification. No browser, real customer, provider, production or hosted-capacity claim.

defects.finding: Unpaired UTF-16 in accepted business names or transcript TEXT is silently replaced by SQLite with U+FFFD.
defects.repair: Reject ill-formed strings in shared text validation before writes.

defects.finding: Authenticated archives can contain escaped unpaired UTF-16 in JSON request fields and publish restored data.
defects.repair: Reuse the shared field validator and reject ill-formed JSON request notes before publishing restore.

compatibility.alreadyReplacedText: cannot reconstruct original code unit; existing U+FFFD remains valid stored text
